title: Daytona Beach Fishing Charter

services.name: Fishing Gear
services.desc: Daytona Beach is widely known as the Shark Bite Capital of the World - and for good reason. Our warm Atlantic waters attract an incredible variety of shark species year-round, making Daytona Beach shark fishing one of the premier experiences in the country. Whether you're a first-time angler or a seasoned shark hunter, Captain Brad's shark fishing charters in Daytona Beach deliver heart-pounding action just miles from shore. Our 3-hour shark fishing charter runs 5-10 miles offshore from New Smyrna Beach, FL, putting you right in the middle of some of the most productive shark fishing near Daytona Beach on Florida's East Coast. We use heavy-duty tackle, fresh cut bait, and proven techniques
